JNJ.rationale: JNJ presents a mixed but mildly attractive picture. On the positive side, the company delivered solid Q2 2026 results with revenue of $25.31B (+6.6% YoY), beat consensus on both top and bottom lines, and raised full-year guidance to $100.8-$101.4B in revenue and $11.60-$11.75 adjusted EPS. The Innovative Medicine segment is performing well with oncology up 16-17% and Tremfya surging 73%, partially offsetting Stelara biosimilar headwinds. The balance sheet is strong with $20.76B cash and manageable net debt of ~$28B. The company is on track to cross $100B in annual revenue for the first time in its 140-year history, and the FDA approval of the OTTAVA robotic surgical system came earlier than expected, providing a potential MedTech catalyst. However, several factors temper enthusiasm: (1) Valuation is stretched — the P/E of 30.1x is near the top of its 365-day range (17.6-31.1x) and represents a significant premium to where it traded just a year ago (~18x). P/B of 7.4x is also at the high of of5-day high.
